_comment: The one registry of elections in this corpus: id -> official Lithuanian
name, a short label for chart axes and the filter dropdown, the first-round
date, and the kind of body elected (seimo | savivaldybiu | prezidento |
ep | mero). Before this file there were three hand-maintained lists --
ELECTION_ORDER in scripts/build_person_index.py plus ELECTION_LABELS and
SHORT_LABELS in dashboard/index.html -- and adding an election meant
editing all three. The last additions edited none of them, so
2011-vasario-27-savivaldybiu (16,400 records) was invisible to the
dashboard and six more elections rendered as raw slugs. See GitHub issue #63.
`date` is the first round; its job is chronological ordering, which is why
entries are stored sorted by it. Dates and scopes come from the election
table in docs/CLI_REFERENCE.md. Adding an election means adding one entry
here -- tests/test_elections_registry.py fails if data/<id>/ exists
without one.
The three fields follow one convention each (issue #121; the same test
file pins all three, so a new entry cannot drift):
- `name` is VRK's own heading form: the registry date in words
(`YYYY m. <mėnesio> D d.`), then `nauji` or `pakartotiniai` when the
election is not a general one, then one body phrase per kind --
`Lietuvos Respublikos Seimo rinkimai`, `savivaldybių tarybų rinkimai`
(2023 adds `ir merų`), `Respublikos Prezidento rinkimai`, `Europos
Parlamento rinkimai`, the named municipality's council or mayor -- and
for a Seimas by-election its constituencies: `X apygardoje Nr. N`, or
`X Nr. N, Y Nr. M ir Z Nr. K apygardose`.
- `shortName` is `YYYY <Institucija>` for a general election and
`YYYY-MM <Institucija>` for everything else; the institution is one
capitalised nominative per kind: Seimas, Savivaldybės, Prezidentas, EP,
Merai. The day joins the label only where two non-general elections
share a month and an institution (the two June 2015 municipal repeats).
- `id` is frozen. It names data/<id>/, the sitemaps, every module's
constants, the release assets and the join key of every export, so the
old ids keep the slug shapes they were born with. A new election's id is
`YYYY-<kind>` for a general election (2028-seimo, 2027-savivaldybiu) and
`YYYY-<menuo>-<D>-<kind>[-<vieta>...]` for anything else
(2026-kovo-15-seimo-zirmunai, 2026-birzelio-7-mero-trakai): ASCII, the
month in the genitive, the day without a leading zero, the kind spelled
exactly as the `kind` field.
